text:
<Table<AuditEvent>
        columns={columns}
        dataSource={data ?? []}
        rowKey="eventId"
        loading={isLoading}
        pagination={{ pageSize: 20, showSizeChanger: true }}
        data-testid="audit-viewer"
        scroll={{ x: 1700 }}
        rowClassName={(record: AuditEvent) =>
          brokenAt === record.eventId
            ? 'audit-row-broken'
            : ''
        }
      />
    </PageContainer>
  );
}

databaseChangeLog:
  - changeSet:
      id: v3-p2-2-idempotency-add-v4-columns
      author: P2-2
      changes:
        - addColumn:
            tableName: idempotency_record
            columns:
              - column:
                  name: id
                  type: uuid
              - column:
                  name: scope_key
                  type: varchar(128)
              - column:
                  name: status
                  type: varchar(16)
              - column:
                  name: resource_id
                  type: uuid
              - column:
                  name: expires_at
                  type: timestamptz

  - changeSet:
      id: v3-p2-2-idempotency-data-migration
      author: P2-2
      changes:
        - sql:
            "UPDATE idempotency_record SET id = gen_random_uuid(), scope_key = idempotency_key, status = 'OK' WHERE scope_key IS NULL"

  - changeSet:
      id: v3-p2-2-idempotency-set-not-null
      author: P2-2
      changes:
        - addNotNullConstraint:
            tableName: idempotency_record
            columnName: id
            columnDataType: uuid
        - addNotNullConstraint:
            tableName: idempotency_record
            columnName: scope_key
            columnDataType: varchar(128)

- changeSet:
      id: v3-p2-2-idempotency-change-pk
      author: P2-2
      changes:
        - sql:
            sql: ALTER TABLE transfer DROP CONSTRAINT IF EXISTS fk_transfer_idempotency
        - addUniqueConstraint:
            tableName: idempotency_record
            columnNames: idempotency_key
            constraintName: uq_idempotency_legacy_key
        - dropPrimaryKey:
            tableName: idempotency_record
        - addPrimaryKey:
            tableName: idempotency_record
            columnNames: id
            constraintName: pk_idempotency_record
        - addUniqueConstraint:
            tableName: idempotency_record
            columnNames: scope_key
            constraintName: uq_idempotency_scope_key
        - sql:
            sql: ALTER TABLE transfer ADD CONSTRAINT fk_transfer_idempotency FOREIGN KEY (idempotency_key) REFERENCES idempotency_record(scope_key)
